name: vune-ui
description: Vune UI compatibility entry point; canonical graph/runtime packages live under @muse/*.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:workspace && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:runtime: node --test tests/react-runtime.test.mjs tests/react-widgets.test.mjs tests/react-client.test.mjs tests/macro-react.test.mjs tests/new-features.test.mjs tests/view-system.test.mjs
scripts.test:packages: node --test tests/core.test.mjs tests/graph-modules.test.mjs tests/compiler-modules.test.mjs tests/web-modules.test.mjs tests/bundle-size.test.mjs tests/react-package.test.mjs tests/web-package.test.mjs tests/vue-package.test.mjs tests/vue-live.test.mjs tests/compiler-package.test.mjs tests/compiler-hardening.test.mjs tests/compiler-parser-fuzz.test.mjs tests/canonical-exports.test.mjs tests/api-surface.test.mjs tests/button-initializers.test.mjs tests/layout-primitives.test.mjs tests/renderer-conformance.test.mjs tests/renderer-conformance-live.test.mjs tests/control-primitives.test.mjs tests/collection-interop.test.mjs tests/presentation-primitives.test.mjs tests/advanced-primitives.test.mjs tests/vscode-extension.test.mjs tests/muse-cli.test.mjs
scripts.benchmark:modifiers:ci: MUSE_BENCH_CI=1 MUSE_BENCH_BASE_RATIO=8 MUSE_BENCH_DEPTH_RATIO=4 pnpm run benchmark:modifiers
scripts.benchmark:performance:ci: MUSE_BENCH_CI=1 pnpm run build && MUSE_BENCH_CI=1 node --expose-gc benchmarks/performance.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test:runtime && pnpm run test:packages && pnpm run test:docs && pnpm run test:release
scripts.demo:parity:build: pnpm run demo:parity:react:build && pnpm run demo:parity:vue:build && pnpm run demo:parity:web:build
scripts.demo:all:build: pnpm run demo:build && pnpm run demo:vue:build && pnpm run demo:web:build && pnpm run demo:parity:build && pnpm run demo:showcase:build
